title: Semi (Theme 3: Utunzaji wa wanyama)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the semi in its kind and occasion, explains its maana with an example, and presents it with the audience taking part.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a riddle or a story with the formula.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

representations: a recording or a performance of "Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba"
steps: Listen to or read the text.
Explain its maana with an example.
contexts: an evening of stories at home

board.do: Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba

board.say: Hii ni semi ya aina gani, na inatumika lini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child presents a short piece with the class responding.

misconceptions.ask: Hutumika lini, na kwa lengo gani?
misconceptions.repair: "Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba" ni tashbihi: mkulima ana nguvu na ujasiri mkubwa kazini.

misconceptions.ask: Ilipokezwa kwa maandishi au kwa mdomo?
misconceptions.repair: Semi ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
Tashbihi hutumika kusifu au kukosoa tabia katika mazungumzo na hadithi.

listen_for: Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
